title: Grave of the Fireflies
synopsis: An older brother, a younger sister, a candy tin of fruit drops, and a country that has run out of room for them.

nodes.text: A B-29 drone over a wooden city.

choices.consequence: “Run for the shelter” closes one possibility and opens another. The moment leaves a clear note behind: Smart.

nodes.text: A janitor opens a tin and shakes the bones into the grass and you watch from somewhere that is not quite anywhere, and Setsuko comes to meet you.
You go back to your aunt's house with your head low and you survive the war by inches, and you spend the rest of your life writing a sister letters she will not read.
Fireflies above the city, your sister's hand small in yours, the war over somewhere you will never need to go again.
